turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you get that notification about the new Snyk report coming in?
Yes, I saw it just now. It covers their latest findings on code security trends.

Cool. I'm actually skeptical about the AI coding tools everyone is pushing. I think Snyk states that the quality of AI-generated code is worse than human-generated code. That's a huge red flag for me.
Understood. That is a significant data point to consider for your team's workflow.
Yeah, I don't want to automate too much if it means introducing subtle bugs. Hey, unrelated: can you check if my order for the mechanical keyboard switches shipped?
I'll check that for you. It looks like the package was scanned at the distribution center this morning.
Great. Also, any chance you could grab me a dinner recommendation for tonight? Something Italian.
I can suggest a few places nearby. Do you prefer casual or fine dining?
